main_body: Open wooden weapon rack: two side posts, a top beam, a middle crossbar and a bottom beam, with four weapons (axe, mace, halberd, sword) standing in front of them
top_band: Top beam: light tan rows 9-11, then mid tan and darker brown front rows 12-14. Bottom beam: light tan rows 26-28, then darker brown front rows 29-31.
evidence: The top beam and bottom beam each have a lighter 3-row horizontal top band above a darker front face. A mid-tone step marks the front edge, and darker rows below it read as an eave shadow. The posts and weapons stand in front, so the open frame reads as 3/4, with beam tops visible. The top bands are shallow, and the crossbar and posts have no inset detail, but both main beams show real top surfaces.

style.evidence: The wood has about 4 steps (light top, mid, dark front, deep shadow). The outline leans dark brown beside wood, with no black sticker line. The weapon heads have 3-4 grey and red steps. The posts and weapon shafts are long, flat dark-brown strips with no grain, knots or speckle, and the beam fronts are also smooth. The references carry about 6 steps per material, with tile scallops, stone shading and grain, so the candidate is plainly thinner and flatter than them.
